Warped creatures can be assigned as a [[Slayer task]] starting at level 56 [[Slayer]] by [[Chaeldar]], [[Konar]], [[Nieve]], [[Duradel]], and [[Mortimer]]. They will only be assigned if the option ''Warped Reality'' is purchased, barring Mortimer who will assign them regardless. Warped creatures are found exclusively in the [[Poison Waste Dungeon]], requiring completion of [[The Path of Glouphrie]].  

Players must have the [[crystal chime]] in their inventory to fight them, otherwise they will be invulnerable. 

[[Warped Tortoise]]s are relatively simple to fight, as they only deal melee damage, which is fully negated by [[Protect from Melee]], although they are weak enough that high [[crush defence]] is sufficient to slay them as well. They are available directly at the entrance of the dungeon, making shorter trips viable as banking with the [[spirit tree]] is easy. They can be [[safespot]]ted by traversing to one of the rooms further in the dungeon, where there are two tortoises surrounded by four pillars in the centre of the room, as well as pillars along the walls. By standing on the east or west of these four pillars in the centre, the player can attack the tortoises using [[ranged]] or [[magic]] without being attacked. Using a halberd also will work in the safespot. There is another safespot in the second room with the one Warped Tortoise, if hit from the angle shown in the image below.

For [[Warped Terrorbird]]s, it is recommended to wear [[earmuffs]] or a [[slayer helmet]] to halve their max hit and reduce chip damage through [[Protect from Missiles]] from their ranging attacks. They can attack with both melee and ranged, and will react to players' protection prayers and will switch the style they attack with after an attack is blocked with the correct prayer. This can be exploited where if only one is able to reach the player at melee distance and others are attacking at a range then players can use Protect from Missiles for a few seconds which will make all attacking terrorbirds switch to melee attacks and attempt to move into melee distance. If they are unable to reach the player doing this they will not switch back to using ranged attacks and instead stop attacking. This can be set up relatively easily by standing in corners so that only one or two of them can reach you with melee while the rest are stuck behind them.

While the warped tortoises are not aggressive, the warped terrorbirds are, and can quickly defeat an unprepared player. The terrorbirds also never lose aggression, making most parts of the dungeon with them unable to be used for safespots.

For players who don't mind killing either monster (as both have different drop tables), the most ideal spot to kill them is in the second large chamber in the dungeon. Place the cannon on top of the north-western tortoise spawn and have Protect from Missiles active. [[Telekinetic Grab]] is useful to grab drops from across the pit.

This setup is used if planning to fight the warped tortoises with use of [[Protect from Melee]], to negate all damage and increase AFK time. [[Prayer]] equipment should be prioritised in order to make AFK times longer. The [[Sarachnis cudgel]] can be substituted for any melee weapon, although the tortoises are weak to [[Crush]], so they are the preferred choice. [[Mace]]s also possess a Prayer bonus of their own, making them extra beneficial for this setup.
*Before obtaining a [[black mask]], replace with the best melee strength or prayer headgear item available, such as the [[helm of Neitiznot]].
*Runes are brought for casting [[High Level Alchemy]] to avoid needing to return to the bank to store valuable item drops.
*[[Earmuffs]] should be worn on the run past the terrorbirds to reach the desired area for fighting tortoises (assuming you do not wish to fight the ones at the entrance), and may be dropped after reaching them if you have a teleport out.
*[[Grand seed pod]] can be replaced with a charged (and worn) [[ring of wealth]], as it will also transport a player near both a [[bank]] and a [[spirit tree]] with its teleport to the [[Grand Exchange]].
* [[Prayer potion]]s can be substituted for [[moonlight moth mix]]es to save on costs, at the cost of trip length.
** [[Black warlock mix]]es and [[ruby harvest mix]]es may also be used to the same effect; although these typically have a very low volume on the Grand Exchange so you would need to create them yourself.

This setup is used for safespotting the warped tortoises, using this {{map|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=safe|text=safespot|zoom=3|mapID=-1|plane=1|x=1505|y=4282}}. Any fast ranged weapon will prove effective, and no resources are needed as the player cannot be reached by the tortoises to be attacked. The [[hunters' sunlight crossbow]] can be substituted for any ranged weapon, and although the tortoises are weak to heavy ranged weapons, such as crossbows, faster weapons like [[shortbow]]s, [[throwing knives]], or the [[toxic blowpipe]] will more often perform better. If your [[Strength]] stat is at least roughly equal to or higher than your [[Ranged]] stat, the [[eclipse atlatl]] can be the best option for them, especially if using high strength bonus items like an [[amulet of strength]], [[barrows gloves]], and [[berserker ring (i)]]. If using the atlatl, remember to bring both [[ranging potion]]s '''and''' [[super strength]] potions.
*[[Proselyte armour]] can be worn instead to save on prayer potions, for only a small loss in dps.
*Prayer potions are not needed if not intending to use [[Eagle Eye]].
*Runes are brought for casting [[High Level Alchemy]] to avoid needing to return to the bank to store valuable item drops.
*Before obtaining or imbuing a [[black mask]], replace with the best ranged or prayer headgear item available, such as a [[mitre]] or [[Shayzien helm 5]].
*[[Earmuffs]] should be worn on the run past the terrorbirds to reach the safespot area, and may be dropped after reaching them if you have a teleport out.
*[[Grand seed pod]] can be replaced with a charged (and worn) [[ring of wealth]], as it will also transport a player near both a [[bank]] and a [[spirit tree]].
* [[Prayer potion]]s can be substituted for [[moonlight moth mix]]es to save on costs, at the cost of trip length.

===Terrorbirds safespotting===
* Must bring a weapon with at least 9 tile of range, such as the [[crystal bow]] or [[Craw's bow]]. [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbows]] and [[Shortbow (weapon)|shortbows]] can also reach while using the "Longrange" attack style, however this results in much less DPS than the previously mentioned weapons.
** If lacking a naturally longrange Ranged weapon like the crystal bow, Craw's bow, or ballista, maging will typically be better damage.
* See images below on how to safespot them using the doors near the entrance.

This setup is used for safespotting the warped tortoises, using this {{map|type=maplink|mtype=pin|group=safe|text=safespot|zoom=3|mapID=-1|plane=1|x=1505|y=4282}}. While generally less damage than using [[Ranged]], it is an alternative option that is still reasonably effective. The [[twinflame staff]] casting [[Earth spells]] is one of the better options for this, although at higher [[Magic]] levels some [[Powered staff|powered staves]] like the [[trident of the seas]] can outperform it, especially if using [[Magic#Temporary skill boosts|boosts]].

*Monk robes can be worn instead to save on prayer potions, for only a small loss in dps, assuming no max hits are lost, such as if you have robes with magic damage like [[Ahrim's robes]].
*Prayer potions are not needed if not intending to use [[Mystic Might]].
*Runes are brought for casting the highest level Earth spell available, and for [[High Level Alchemy]] to avoid needing to return to the bank to store valuable item drops. Using a [[dust battlestaff]] or the twinflame staff will provide the elemental runes for each spell, respectively.
*Before obtaining or imbuing a [[black mask]], replace with the best magic or prayer headgear item available, such as a [[mitre]] or [[bloodbark helm]].
* For [[Ironman mode|Ironmen]], the [[occult necklace]] should be replaced with either a [[stole]], [[unholy symbol]], or [[amulet of magic]], as it cannot be obtained until a much higher [[Slayer]] level.
*[[Earmuffs]] should be worn on the run past the terrorbirds to reach the safespot area, and may be dropped after reaching them if you have a teleport out.
*[[Grand seed pod]] can be replaced with a charged (and worn) [[ring of wealth]], as it will also transport a player near both a [[bank]] and a [[spirit tree]].
* [[Prayer potion]]s can be substituted for [[moonlight moth mix]]es to save on costs, at the cost of trip length.
* [[Magic potion]]s or [[forgotten brew]]s may be optionally brought if using a powered staff, as they will often gain substantial DPS when boosted.

===Terrorbirds safespotting===
* All magic weapons and cast spells are able to reach the terrorbirds for the safespot, except for the [[Eye of Ayak]]. As warped terrorbirds lack an elemental weakness, a powered staff on the "Longrange" attack style will be better on average.
** If lacking a naturally longrange Ranged weapon like the [[crystal bow]], [[Craw's bow]], or [[ballista]], maging will typically be better damage.
* See images below on how to safespot them using the doors near the entrance.

===Cannoning===
<!--insert a picture of a good spot to put a cannon, cannon plugin says 1490,4263 is the optimal tile to cannon here-->
One of the best locations to place a cannon is {{map|type=maplink|x:1490,y:4263|mapID=-1|plane=1|mtype=pin|group=cannon|text=here}} and standing up against a wall or waste pit. Most terrorbirds that are targeted by the cannon will never be able to attack you. This is due to the monster's [[pathfinding]] causing them to be stuck on the other side of the waste pit and eachother.

===Gallery===
Below are some visual examples of areas where Warped Creatures can be safespotted, but there are more that are not shown throughout the cave, as there are many small obstacles, waste pits, and corners. Any of the safespots further in the dungeon require protect from missiles and earmuffs to safely reach, but can be a useful option if the entrance is already occupied by another player.
